g.text: G2 What must run, and what must wait?

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: Formal name: work and capacity. Resource means something jobs compete to use, such as a GPU worker or a locked renderer.

g.text: VARIABLE / UNIT

g.text: ms duration
Time spent executing one stage, excluding the wait
we model separately. It need not be constant.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #7448d1
font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #7448d1

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: resource / process identifier
Which computer, device or protected worker runs
stage v; for example, the shared H200 renderer.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #7448d1
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #7448d1

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: simultaneous execution slots
How many jobs resource q can actually run at once.
q names a resource; it is not tick resolution r.

g.text: session count
How many sessions are allowed into the system.
More admitted work does not create execution slots.

g.text: ordering policy
Which waiting job resource q serves next: for example,
arrival order or earliest deadline first.

Time between being ready to run and actually running.
A busy resource or scheduling choice can cause it.

the chosen finish boundary, including later steps.

Negative slack predicts a late finish.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: Critical path
Longest chain of required earlier work.
Work time alone excludes resource waits.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
Completion depends on both execution cost and competition for the same resource. Model, input length,
hardware and cache state can change C; the queue rule and available slots determine additional waiting.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1
